+"""
+Loads the bytes of an image named by a reference a user can set (a cut's
+image_path, a style reference, a character image, ...).
+
+Such a reference is never requested as a URL: that would let a user make the
+backend call any address it can reach, including ones inside our network
+(SSRF). It is read only when it is one of:
+
+- a data: URL, decoded in place;
+- an object in our storage, given as a relative path or as its full URL
+  (STORAGE_HOST/<path>), read through the storage client;
+- one of the built-in style presets, which live at a fixed public address.
+
+Everything else is refused and loads as None.
+"""
+import base64
+import re
+import urllib.parse
+from typing import Optional
+
+import requests
+
+from app.core.config import settings
+from app.core.logging import get_logger
+from app.services.storage import GCSStorage, storage
+
+logger = get_logger(__name__)
+
+# Built-in style presets offered by the frontend (ArtStyleSetupModal).
+PRESET_STYLE_BASE = "https://storage.googleapis.com/toonify-prod-assets/styles/presets/"
+_PRESET_NAME = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\.[A-Za-z0-9]+")
+_SCHEME = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9+.-]*:")
+
+
+def _storage_bases() -> list[str]:
+    """URL prefixes under which the objects of our own storage are published."""
+    bases = []
+    if settings.STORAGE_HOST:
+        bases.append(settings.STORAGE_HOST.rstrip("/") + "/")
+    if isinstance(storage, GCSStorage):
+        bases.append(f"https://storage.googleapis.com/{storage.bucket_name}/")
+    return bases
+
+
+def storage_key(ref: str) -> Optional[str]:
+    """
+    Returns the storage path a reference points at, or None when the
+    reference is not an object in our storage.
+    """
+    for base in _storage_bases():
+        if ref.startswith(base):
+            path = ref[len(base):].split("#", 1)[0].split("?", 1)[0]
+            return urllib.parse.unquote(path) or None
+    if _SCHEME.match(ref) or ref.startswith("//") or "\\" in ref:
+        # Some other URL: not ours.
+        return None
+    return ref
+
+
+def _decode_data_url(ref: str) -> Optional[bytes]:
+    try:
+        _header, encoded = ref.split(",", 1)
+        return base64.b64decode(encoded)
+    except Exception:
+        return None
+
+
+def load_image_bytes(ref: Optional[str]) -> Optional[bytes]:
+    """Returns the image bytes for a reference, or None if it cannot (or must not) be loaded."""
+    if not ref or not isinstance(ref, str):
+        return None
+    ref = ref.strip()
+    try:
+        if ref[:5].lower() == "data:":
+            return _decode_data_url(ref)
+
+        key = storage_key(ref)
+        if key is not None:
+            return storage.download_image(key)
+
+        if ref.startswith(PRESET_STYLE_BASE) and _PRESET_NAME.fullmatch(ref[len(PRESET_STYLE_BASE):]):
+            res = requests.get(ref, timeout=30, allow_redirects=False)
+            return res.content if res.status_code == 200 else None
+
+        logger.warning("Refused to load image from a URL outside our storage", url=ref[:200])
+        return None
+    except Exception as e:
+        logger.warning("Failed to load image", error=str(e))
+        return None

+"""Exports say which cuts they left out: missing.txt in the ZIP and the
+X-Missing-Cuts header on both formats."""
+import base64
+import io
+import zipfile
+
+import pytest
+
+from tests.conftest import signup
+from tests.lab_env import PNG, FakeMinio
+
+DATA_URL = "data:image/png;base64," + base64.b64encode(PNG).decode()
+NOT_AN_IMAGE = "data:image/png;base64," + base64.b64encode(b"not an image").decode()
+REFUSED = "http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/"
+NOT_IN_STORAGE = "cuts/test/gone.png"
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
+def no_network(monkeypatch):
+    import requests
+
+    def refuse(self, method, url, **kwargs):
+        raise AssertionError(f"export requested {url}")
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(requests.Session, "request", refuse)
+    FakeMinio.objects.clear()
+
+
+def make_episode(client, headers, image_paths):
+    """Creates an episode with one cut per entry, numbered from 1; None leaves the cut without an image."""
+    r = client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=headers, json={"title": "Night Bus", "genres": []})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    r = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/episodes",
+        headers=headers,
+        json={"title": "Ep 1", "project_id": r.json()["id"], "episode_order": 1},
+    )
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    episode_id = r.json()["id"]
+    for order, image_path in enumerate(image_paths, start=1):
+        r = client.post("/api/v1/cuts", headers=headers, json={"episode_id": episode_id, "cut_order": order})
+        assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+        if image_path is not None:
+            r = client.put(f"/api/v1/cuts/{r.json()['id']}", headers=headers, json={"image_path": image_path})
+            assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return episode_id
+
+
+def export(client, headers, episode_id, format):
+    return client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{episode_id}/export?format={format}", headers=headers)
+
+
+def test_zip_lists_missing_cuts_in_missing_txt_and_header(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    episode_id = make_episode(client, h, [DATA_URL, None, REFUSED, DATA_URL, NOT_IN_STORAGE])
+
+    r = export(client, h, episode_id, "zip")
+
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert r.headers["X-Missing-Cuts"] == "2,3,5"
+    with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(r.content)) as zf:
+        assert sorted(zf.namelist()) == ["Ep_1_01.png", "Ep_1_04.png", "missing.txt"]
+        assert zf.read("missing.txt").decode() == "2\n3\n5\n"
+
+
+def test_zip_without_missing_cuts_has_no_missing_txt_and_no_header(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    episode_id = make_episode(client, h, [DATA_URL, DATA_URL])

+    r = export(client, h, episode_id, "zip")
+
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text

+    with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(r.content)) as zf:

+def test_strip_without_missing_cuts_has_no_header(client):
+    h = signup(client)

+
+    r = export(client, h, episode_id, "webtoon")
+
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert "X-Missing-Cuts" not in r.headers
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("format", ["zip", "webtoon"])
